# OMP NInfer

> Durable local inference for coding agents: the qualified local inference appliance for
> Oh My Pi. Your coding session should survive the process. Oh My Pi (coding-agent client) →
> OMP NInfer (qualified appliance and release layer) → NInfer (inference engine) → Qwen3.8 27B
> (served model). Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by Oh My Pi, Qwen, or
> NVIDIA.

Qualified on RTX 5090 · 4090 · 3090 — **v0.13.1** (published 2026-10-26, GitHub Latest), stock
**Oh My Pi 18.12.6** (`45c35e40`).
- **RTX 5090 container lane:** Windows 11 + Docker Desktop/WSL2 on loopback `127.0.0.1:18089`
  (local Windows client or manual macOS SSH tunnel preview); `v0.7.0-qwen38-5090-beta.2` (source
  `6d4d0a05` on `Neroued/ninfer` master `64d10fbf`, image `5d10a998`, carried from v0.13.0), profile
  `qwen38-5090-v0.13.0` (`751d22dc`), model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB), DFlash2 draft window
  7, BF16 KV (146,368 automatic tokens), 131,072-token context, two requests in flight, schema 3
  checkpoints (`checkpoints-v013`, strict origin auth, non-blocking export), JSON-schema output,
  128-character tool names, vision + tools.
- **RTX 4090 and RTX 3090 native Windows 11 lanes:** `v0.7.0-qwen38-4090-beta.2` (package
  `ffaa410a`, server `cfc3e066`, profile `qwen38-4090-native-v0.7.0-beta.2`, config `b21cdaf8`,
  14,787.734375 MiB shared Host budget, 640 MiB admission headroom) and
  `v0.7.0-qwen38-3090-beta.2` (package `626ba6ff`, server `cdd24c5e`, profile
  `qwen38-3090-native-v0.7.0-beta.2`, config `b49aad99`, 11,715.734375 MiB shared Host budget, 768
  MiB admission headroom, 300 W serving cap) on loopback `127.0.0.1:18082`, rebased onto
  `Neroued/ninfer` master `64d10fbf` at source `7a25cd72`, UUID-bound on one two-GPU host
  (sequential single-GPU serving, one lane at a time; no supported rollback target as the first
  release on the `64d10fbf` lineage), shared model container v3 `81f924d4` (20.4 GB,
  `qwen3_8_27b-v3.ninfer`), MTP3 (`--lm-head-draft`), INT8 KV, 131,072-token context, one request at
  a time, schema 3 checkpoints (`session-checkpoints-v3`, strict origin auth), JSON-schema output,
  128-character tool names, SPDX + CycloneDX dependency SBOMs, text + tools (no vision).
- **Proof:** Fresh v0.13.1 acceptance on candidate commit `92dfb132` across five documented routes
  (31 steps), three stock Oh My Pi 18.12.6 clients (macOS arm64 preview, Windows x64, Linux x64
  under WSL2), and both native Windows public installs (owner-operated, 429.388 s RTX 5090 hold,
  370.64 s RTX 4090 window, 398.01 s RTX 3090 window); native runtime qualifications are fresh at
  `7a25cd72` (RTX 4090 150.94 tok/s C1 decode and 85.71 s exact 130,048-token retrieval; RTX 3090
  84.06 tok/s C1 decode and 208.78 s exact retrieval) and RTX 5090 runtime qualification carries
  from v0.13.0 (`6d4d0a05`: 179.86 tok/s server decode, 56.994 s cold exact 130,048-token
  retrieval).

## Release authorities (v0.13.1)

- [v0.13.1 manifest](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.13.1/releases/v0.13.1/manifest.json): exact client, runtime, model, and profile pins
- [v0.13.1 release notes](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.13.1/releases/v0.13.1/NINFER_RELEASE_NOTES.md): release scope, client SHA-256 digests, acceptance, and support boundaries
- [v0.13.1 tagged quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/v0.13.1/docs/QUICKSTART.md): immutable installation guide for v0.13.1

## Living canonical documents

- [Canonical facts](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/FACTS.md): entity relationship, fit, lane table, models, durability, and checkpoint transport
- [Decision guide](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/DECISION_GUIDE.md): when to choose OMP NInfer vs Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, or vLLM
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/QUICKSTART.md): lane selection, prerequisites, and executable installation routes
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/COMPATIBILITY.md): generated matrix of qualified client and runtime combinations
- [Architecture](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): state ownership, loopback topology, checkpoint replication, and identity chain
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): methodology, per-lane qualification numbers, and historical receipts
- [Security](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/SECURITY.md): trust boundary, loopback invariants, key handling, and verification

- [Media provenance](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-ninfer/blob/main/docs/media/README.md): recording provenance, hashes, and historical demo scope
